title: Bevy still crashes when mesh attributes are different lengths

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

body:
## Bevy version

main

## Relevant system information

```
AdapterInfo { name: "Apple M1 Max", vendor: 0, device: 0, device_type: IntegratedGpu, driver: "", driver_info: "", backend: Metal }
SystemInfo { os: "MacOS 13.5.1 ", kernel: "22.6.0", cpu: "Apple M1 Max", core_count: "10", memory: "64.0 GiB" }
```

## What you did

Add one more UV in the `generate_custom_mesh` example and `cargo run --example generate_custom_mesh`.

```diff
diff --git a/examples/3d/generate_custom_mesh.rs b/examples/3d/generate_custom_mesh.rs
index a4aa02502..51b0fae24 100644
--- a/examples/3d/generate_custom_mesh.rs
+++ b/examples/3d/generate_custom_mesh.rs
@@ -181,6 +181,8 @@ fn create_cube_mesh() -> Mesh {
             [0.0, 0.45], [0.0, 0.2], [1.0, 0.2], [1.0, 0.45],
             // Assigning the UV coords for the forward side.
             [0.0, 0.45], [0.0, 0.2], [1.0, 0.2], [1.0, 0.45],
+            // extra
+            [0.0, 0.0]
         ],
     );

```

## What went wrong

Warning is emitted, but Bevy still crashes.

The warning seems to imply that Bevy should not be crashing.

```
2023-10-25T20:12:41.865953Z  WARN bevy_render::mesh::mesh: MeshVertexAttributeId(2) has a different vertex count (28) than other attributes (24) in this mesh, all attributes will be truncated to match the smallest.
```
```
thread 'Compute Task Pool (0)' panicked at crates/bevy_render/src/mesh/mesh/mod.rs:370:46:
range end index 800 out of range for slice of length 768
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
Encountered a panic in system `bevy_render::render_asset::prepare_assets<bevy_render::mesh::mesh::Mesh>`!
thread 'Compute Task Pool (3)' panicked at crates/bevy_render/src/pipelined_rendering.rs:145:45:
called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: RecvError
```

## Additional information

I attempted to bisect this, but I see the same crash even with #9699 where the warning was introduced.

First noticed here: <https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/10259#pullrequestreview-1698045156>.
